component.name: Resona
component.summary: The sound enhancer Linux never had

description.p: Resona adds system-wide spatial audio, psychoacoustic bass, Intelligent EQ, AutoEq headphone correction, a convolver, and stereo-to-5.1/7.1 upmixing to PipeWire through a native, lock-free DSP engine with a Material 3 Expressive interface.
